name: md2ui-demo
description: Claude shows its answers as UI in an md2ui window, and hears your clicks.
long_description: A local demo of md2ui. Claude answers in md2ui Markdown; `show` opens the answer in md2ui's window; `wait_for_event` returns your next click as a sentence; `mark` ticks, unticks or disables what was shown. The extension holds no md2ui code: it runs the published md2ui package (md2ui==0.1.0a1) with uvx, so it needs uv installed. Its previews load pictures, and the fonts md2ui locks, as the window does.

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show your reply to the user in the md2ui window: a UI, a plain answer, or both. Plain Markdown: nothing in it runs. Offer next steps you can take as agent: buttons, and include the pictures your data came with. Then it listens, and returns what the user did.

tools.name: wait_for_event
tools.description: Wait for the user's next click, as a sentence, or a message typed into the window. The window is heard only while a wait is open; each result says what to do next.

tools.name: mark
tools.description: Tick, untick, disable or set the value of a target of a shown response, or move a bar by its key, in place.

tools.name: feed
tools.description: Let a process you run move bars on a shown page by posting Key: value lines to a local URL, costing no turns; it ends itself.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: A PNG of the md2ui window as it is on screen, to check what the user sees.

tools.name: status
tools.description: The state the window was last told, and whether one is still connected.

tools.name: showing
tools.description: What the window holds, as data: the live Markdown, its offers, and what the user asked for.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Replace one section or one link of a page you showed, without re-sending the rest.

tools.name: history
tools.description: The pages shown this session, one row each: id, title, age, sources and stale sections.

tools.name: check
tools.description: Authoring issues in an md2ui response.

tools.name: actions
tools.description: What a response offers the user, numbered as a click reports it.

tools.name: outline
tools.description: The grouped structure, one node per line.

tools.name: layout
tools.description: The layout shape at a width.

tools.name: preview
tools.description: A PNG of a response, with its pictures loaded as in the user's window.

tools.name: guide
tools.description: md2ui's authoring notes, by name; the core note first.

theme.title: THEME.md
theme.description: Your theme. Leave empty for md2ui's default theme.
